reviewer: Codex independent read-only content and integrity review

manifest_binding.meaning: The manifest hash and all file hashes below were computed from the bytes present in the reviewed v4 directory.

review_scope.content: Read every user and assistant message in all 24 teacher dialogues and checked role boundaries, Chinese expression, factual and logical consistency, task adherence, uncertainty handling, leakage of existing development material or internal project details, unsupported identity or firsthand-experience claims, and value framing.
review_scope.integrity: Read manifest.json; recomputed SHA-256 for manifest.json and all four JSONL artifacts; verified the declared source curriculum manifest and tokenizer hashes; parsed every JSONL row; checked row counts, row-level teacher SHA-256 values, group bindings, reconstructed text, role alternation, token-mask lengths, and masked-target totals.
review_scope.limits: Read-only review only. No training, fine-tuning, checkpoint evaluation, or input-file modification was performed. The 65 foundations rows were checked for parse, count, and token binding integrity; line-by-line content review covers the requested 24 teacher dialogues.

pilot_decision.reason: All 24 teacher dialogues are coherent, bounded low-stakes examples of multi-turn reference, correction, clarification, unknown-fact handling, instruction following, simple reasoning, and ordinary interpersonal values. The v4 revision makes the box-counting criterion explicit by consistently referring to usable empty boxes. No material content or integrity blocker was found.
conditions: Use a short predeclared step or token budget and retain the parent checkpoint for rollback.
Run fixed before-and-after multi-turn evaluations for semantic correctness, correction handling, repetition, and role boundaries; do not rely on loss alone.
Stop on semantic regression, increased repetition, or persistent failure to preserve corrected context.
Treat this as a small authored pilot set; approval does not establish broad chat ability or authorize an unrestricted training run.

overall_assessment.summary: The set preserves dialogue-local facts, applies user corrections, distinguishes unknown information from known information, and avoids unsupported assistant biography. The only notable scope limitation is the small authored size and its resulting overfitting risk.

Encourages direct admission and repair; the honesty and responsibility labels fit the situation.

Uses only the stated potatoes and carrots and respects the preference for few seasonings.
Acknowledges that the location is unknown and does not fabricate a nearby bus stop.
